name: @activepieces/piece-chat-data
description: Build AI-chatbots with support for live chat escalation, knowledge bases, or custom backend endpoints.

auth.description: Enter your Chat Data API key

create_chatbot.name: create_chatbot
create_chatbot.description: Create and train a chatbot using custom data, medical models, or custom models. Training takes 1-2 minutes.

chatbotName.description: The name of the chatbot to be created

model.description: Select the chatbot model. Note: sourceText and urlsToScrape are ignored for medical and custom models.

sourceText.description: Training text for the chatbot. Character limits apply based on your plan. Only used for custom-data-upload model.

urlsToScrape.description: URLs to extract content from. Must start with http:// or https:// (only for custom-data-upload model)

url.description: Website URL starting with http:// or https://

products.description: List of products for training the chatbot

id.description: Unique ID for tracking the product in the knowledge base

information.description: Structured data of the product in key-value format (1-2 levels deep recommended)

qAndAs.description: List of questions and answers for the chatbot to learn

question.description: The question on a specific topic

customBackend.description: URL of a custom backend for the chatbot

bearer.description: Authentication bearer token for custom backend

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new Chat Data chatbot and kicks off training. The model prop selects the mode: custom-data-upload trains on supplied source text, scraped URLs, products, and Q&As; medical-chat-human / medical-chat-vet use prebuilt medical models; custom-model proxies to your own backend (the data-source props are ignored for the medical and custom-model modes). Use to provision a brand-new bot. Not idempotent — each call creates a separate chatbot.

delete_chatbot.name: delete_chatbot
delete_chatbot.description: Delete a chatbot and all its associated data (training data, conversations, leads, etc.). This action is irreversible.

auth.description: Enter your Chat Data API key

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes a Chat Data chatbot identified by chatbotId, along with all of its training data, conversations, and leads. Use only when the bot should be fully removed; the deletion is irreversible. Not idempotent — a repeat call for an already-deleted chatbot will fail.

send_message.name: send_message
send_message.description: Send messages to a chatbot and receive a response with support for streaming and OpenAI-compatible formats

chatbotId.description: Select the chatbot to send message to

auth.description: Enter your Chat Data API key

messageContent.description: The text content of the message to send

messageRole.description: The role of the message sender

auth.description: Enter your Chat Data API key

conversationId.description: Select an existing conversation or leave empty to start a new one

includeReasoning.description: Include reasoning in the response (overrides chatbot settings)

baseModel.description: Override the chatbot's base model for this request

basePrompt.description: Override the chatbot's base prompt for this request

appendMessages.description: Append this message to previous messages with the same conversationId

attachedFiles.description: Files to attach to the message (max 3 files)

name.description: The name of the attached file

type.description: The MIME type of the file

url.description: Publicly accessible URL where the file is hosted

content.description: Pre-parsed textual content. If provided, file won't be downloaded. Required for files > 3MB.

aiMetadata.description: Sends a message to a Chat Data chatbot (selected by chatbotId) and returns its generated reply. Leave conversationId empty to start a new conversation or pass one to continue an existing thread. Per-request overrides (base model, base prompt, reasoning, OpenAI-compatible output) are optional. Use to converse with or query a deployed bot. Not idempotent — each call generates a fresh reply and appends to the conversation.

update_chatbot_settings.name: update_chatbot_settings
update_chatbot_settings.description: Update comprehensive settings for a chatbot including name, prompts, behavior, and appearance

auth.description: Enter your Chat Data API key

chatbotName.description: Update the name of the chatbot

basePrompt.description: Update the base prompt for the chatbot

initialMessages.description: Array of initial messages to be used by the chatbot

suggestedMessages.description: Array of suggested messages shown in the chatbot

visibility.description: Control whether your chatbot is accessible to others

baseModel.description: The AI model used in the RAG processing pipeline

storeChat.description: Whether chat history will be stored on the server

trackIpAddress.description: Whether IP addresses will be stored for conversations and leads

rateLimitPoints.description: Maximum number of messages per timeframe from one device

rateLimitTimeframe.description: Timeframe in seconds for rate limiting

rateLimitMessage.description: Error message shown when rate limited

onlyAllowOnAddedDomains.description: Only allow the iframe and widget on specific domains

domains.description: Array of domains where the chatbot is allowed

showCalendar.description: Display Calendly booking button in the chatbot

calendarMessage.description: Message to display for appointment scheduling

enableBouncingAnimation.description: Whether the chatbot bubble should bounce to attract attention

ignoreDataSource.description: Ignore custom data and act like pure ChatGPT

customBackend.description: URL of a custom backend for the chatbot

aiMetadata.description: Updates configuration of an existing chatbot (selected by chatbotId) — name, base prompt, model, temperature, initial/suggested messages, visibility, rate limits, allowed domains, calendar booking, and other behavior/appearance settings. Only the fields you provide are changed. Use to reconfigure a bot without retraining it. Idempotent: re-applying the same settings leaves the chatbot in the same state.

retrain_chatbot.name: retrain_chatbot
retrain_chatbot.description: Retrain an existing chatbot with new data or remove existing data (custom-data-upload model only)

auth.description: Enter your Chat Data API key

sourceText.description: New text data for training the chatbot

urlsToScrape.description: List of URLs to extract content from (existing URLs will be recrawled)

url.description: Website URL starting with http:// or https://

extractMainContent.description: Automatically remove headers, footers, nav, sidebar, and ads

excludeTags.description: CSS selectors to exclude from scraping (comma-separated)

products.description: List of products for training (existing products with same ID will be overwritten)

id.description: Unique ID for tracking the product

information.description: Structured product data in key-value format

qAndAs.description: List of questions and answers for the chatbot to learn

question.description: The question on a specific topic

deletes.description: List of knowledge sources to remove from the chatbot

type.description: The type of knowledge chunk to delete

url.description: The URL to delete (required if type is website)

aiMetadata.description: Retrains a custom-data-upload chatbot (selected by chatbotId) by adding source text, scraped URLs, products, and Q&As, and/or removing existing knowledge sources via the deletes list. Use to refresh or extend a bot's knowledge base; only works for the custom-data-upload model. Not idempotent — each call mutates the knowledge base (re-crawls URLs, appends/overwrites entries, deletes sources).

upload_file.name: upload_file
upload_file.description: Upload a file to be used with a chatbot for training or knowledge base

auth.description: Enter your Chat Data API key

chatbotId.description: Select the chatbot to upload file to

file.description: The file to upload to the chatbot

aiMetadata.description: Uploads a file to a Chat Data chatbot (selected by chatbotId) to add it to the bot's knowledge base / training data. Use when knowledge should come from a document rather than text or URLs. Not idempotent — each call adds another file to the chatbot.
